headline: For Groups Who Want to Cross an Ocean
primaryText:
This is not a charter week. It is the Atlantic, crossed under sail.

Oguz Khan is a private 50-meter sailing yacht, and each crossing carries 1 group. It suits friends or family who live well together in a small space and care more about the achievement than the itinerary.

Stand a night watch under a sky with no city lights. Sit in on the weather and navigation briefings. Fish, watch for wildlife, or simply enjoy the quiet. 10 crew look after up to 12 guests, all the way across.

From €180,000 for the whole yacht, plus catering and taxes. Westbound in November 2026, eastbound in April 2027.

Request the crossing details below.
whyItWorks: It opens by rejecting the ordinary charter idea, which sets up the crossing as a rare achievement rather than a holiday. It speaks to a specific kind of group and sets a clear price anchor, so only serious, well-off buyers respond. The sunset video with big text 'Open Ocean' adds a vivid sense of escape. It is only days old with very low impressions, so there is no performance signal yet.
